points.description: States that a stack is a data structure (data structure / डेटा स्ट्रक्चर).
States that a stack stores elements/items (elements को store करता है).
States the LIFO principle, i.e. Last-In-First-Out (या last-in-first-out).
Explains that the item added last is removed first (सबसे अंत में जोड़ा गया item सबसे पहले हटाया जाएगा).

rubric.notes: Full marks require all four points: stack as a data structure, storing elements, the LIFO principle, and the explanation that the last-added item is removed first. Award each point only when the student's answer contains that specific idea; equivalent wording in Hindi or English is acceptable. No marks for unrelated or empty answers, and a bare example without a definition earns only the points it explicitly supports.
